description: Outbound messages correctly serialized to JSON-RPC requests. For any valid outbound message, serializing to JSON-RPC send_message and parsing in the sidecar produces identical content.

preconditions.description: A valid outbound message with non-empty destination_hash, non-empty content, and valid priority

expectedOutcome.description: The JSON-RPC send_message request preserves destination_hash, content, and priority through serialization round-trip
